title: Search the Dentro commerce-merchant directory. Query by keyword, country, or cat
description: Search the Dentro commerce-merchant directory. Query by keyword, country, or category and receive a list of consented independent e-commerce stores (domain, name, country, category, platform). Use this to discover stores before pulling their full catalog with /products/:merchant_id, or use /search to query products across all merchants in one call. 22,000+ brands across 16 countries; covers shopify, woocommerce, magento, custom storefronts. No API key required, pay per call.
